hero.h1: Pressure Washing in Holly Springs, NC
hero.intro: Holly Springs is one of the fastest-growing communities in southern Wake County — and keeping up with your home's exterior is part of what makes this town shine. AAA Houston Pressure Washing, LLC delivers 5-star exterior cleaning to Holly Springs homeowners who demand the best.

intro_body: From the established neighborhoods near Bass Lake to the newer subdivisions off Avent Ferry Road, our crew has cleaned them all. We understand Holly Springs' unique mix of brick, vinyl, and hardie plank homes, and we tailor our pressure and soft-wash approach to match every surface perfectly. Fully insured, and backed by over a decade of experience serving Raleigh and surrounding cities.

services.body: Remove oil stains, tire marks, mold, and embedded grime from concrete and asphalt driveways.
Safe soft washing for vinyl, hardie plank, brick, stucco, and wood siding.
Restore concrete, pavers, and brick patios to their original clean appearance.
Eliminate algae, mold, and slip hazards from walkways and entryways.
Clean wood, vinyl, and metal fences to remove mold, mildew, and discoloration.
Low-pressure soft washing for delicate surfaces including roofs and painted wood.
Professional biocide treatments to kill mold and algae at the root.
Full-service commercial exterior cleaning for Holly Springs businesses and property managers.
